434	  /**

465	  /**

472	   */
473	  external_ref: { lab: 'Lakeview Labs'; accession: string; result_code: string };
474	
475	  /** Northgate order number the result answers, e.g. "NO-2021-55120". Absent for results Lakeview sent without a Northgate order (standing orders). */
476	  order_id?: string;
477	}

557	/**
558	 * Consumer views, version 2: the small shapes a patient-facing chart app reads.
559	 *
560	 * These are defined by the consumer, not by any source. A mapper turns one source's FOLIO record items
561	 * for one patient into these rows. The consumer merges rows from several sources itself, so a mapper
562	 * reports only what its own source says, and never invents, infers from other sources, or "corrects"
563	 * what the source records.
564	 *
565	 * Contract (see `Transform`): the mapper receives every item one source published for one patient,
566	 * in no particular order and including items that were later superseded or retracted, plus an
567	 * `asOf` date. It returns the rows that describe that source's record as it stood at the end of that
568	 * date.
569	 *
570	 * Conventions for every view:
571	 *
572	 * - **Scope in time.** An item is in scope when its envelope `recorded` time is on or before the end of
573	 *   the `asOf` day in America/Chicago. Ignore items recorded later. Apply the FOLIO correction rules to
574	 *   the items in scope: an item listed in another in-scope item's `supersedes` or `retracts` (same
575	 *   issuer) is not current; supersession is transitive. Use only current items, except where a view
576	 *   below says otherwise.
577	 * - **Time zone.** The consumer displays everything in America/Chicago, the patients' home zone. "Local
578	 *   date" and "local time" below mean wall-clock date/time in America/Chicago (UTC-6 standard, UTC-5
579	 *   daylight time). A date-time with no offset and no zone (for example a phone's wall clock) is taken to
580	 *   be America/Chicago local time: report it as written, do not shift it, and do not leave it out.
581	 * - **Partial dates.** `PartialDate` strings keep the precision the source actually knows: "2016"
582	 *   means some time in 2016, never 2016-01-01. Never pad a year-only or month-only date.
583	 * - **Only what the source records.** Rows come from structured payload entries. Narrative text may be
584	 *   used to understand an entry but must not be the only basis for a row.
585	 * - **Evidence.** Every row lists the items (and payload entry ids) it was built from, so the consumer
586	 *   can show the source text behind a fact. Cite at least the item whose entry gives the row's current
587	 *   state.
588	 * - **Sensitive entries are reported, never dropped.** Report every entry the source holds, including
589	 *   ones it marks restricted, confidential or sensitive. Mark such rows with `sensitivity` (see
590	 *   `Sensitivity`). Whether a sensitive fact is shown or shared is decided later, by the patient, at
591	 *   disclosure time; it is never decided by a mapper.
592	 * - **Determinism.** Same input, same output: no clock, randomness, network or file access.
593	 */
594	
595	/** A FOLIO record item in its JSON form (see the FOLIO record-item spec). */
596	export interface FolioItem {
597	  folio: string;
598	  /** Item id (ULID), unique within the issuer. */
599	  id: string;
600	  /** did:web of the issuing organization. */
601	  issuer: string;
602	  /** Patient id at this issuer. */
603	  patient: string;
604	  /** When the clinical event happened: RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a full or partial date. */
605	  effective: string;
606	  effective_end?: string;
607	  /** When the issuer committed this item: RFC 3339 date-time with offset. */
608	  recorded: string;
609	  author?: { id?: string; name?: string; role?: string };
610	  /** The payload's schema: `type` names the entry type in the source's .d.ts. */
611	  schema?: { url: string; type: string; sha256: string };
612	  /** Ids of earlier items from the same issuer that this item replaces entirely. */
613	  supersedes?: string[];
614	  /** Ids of earlier items from the same issuer that were entered in error, withdrawn without replacement. */
615	  retracts?: string[];
616	  /** Markdown narrative with `<ref id="…">…</ref>` spans; "" if none. */
617	  narrative: string;
618	  /** Entry id -> entry, each entry typed by the source's schema; {} if none. */
619	  payload: Record<string, any>;
620	}

622	/** The mapper's entry point. `asOf` is a local date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. */
623	export type Transform = (items: FolioItem[], asOf: string) => ViewRows;
